metadata.title: Privacy Policy | BDKinc
metadata.description: Learn how BDKinc protects your privacy and handles your personal information with transparency and care.

hero.description: Your privacy is important to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.introduction: We collect information you voluntarily provide to us, such as when you fill out forms, request services, or contact us via email or phone. This includes:
informationWeCollect.contactDetails: Contact information (name, email address, phone number, company name)
informationWeCollect.technicalDetails: Technical information such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited

howWeUse.heading: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.introduction: We use the information we collect for legitimate business purposes, including:
howWeUse.inquiries: Responding to your inquiries and requests
howWeUse.analysis: Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience

informationSharing.heading: Information Sharing
informationSharing.providers: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business, such as hosting providers, payment processors, and communication platforms. These service providers are contractually obligated to use your information only as necessary to provide services to us.
informationSharing.disclosure: We may also disclose information when required by law or when necessary to protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property.

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.measures: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes SSL encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits.
dataSecurity.limitations: However, no method of internet transmission is completely secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

yourRights.heading: Your Rights
yourRights.introduction: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
yourRights.objection: Objection to processing of your information
yourRights.portability: Data portability and withdrawal of consent
yourRights.exercise: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided in the "Contact Us" section below.

cookiesTracking.heading: Cookies & Tracking
cookiesTracking.usage: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your user experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and analyze site usage.
cookiesTracking.controls: You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. However, disabling cookies may affect your ability to use certain features of our website.
cookiesTracking.analytics: We use analytics tools to understand how visitors interact with our site, enabling us to improve functionality and user experience.

thirdPartyLinks.heading: Third-Party Links
thirdPartyLinks.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites before providing your information.

childrensPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.body: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, we will take steps to delete such information and terminate the child's account.

changesToPolicy.heading: Changes to This Policy
changesToPolicy.body: We may update this privacy policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last Updated" date. Your continued use of our services after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

contactUs.heading: Contact Us
contactUs.introduction: If you have questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your information, please contact us:
